svg.title: Audit Prices and Delivery Expenditure
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-audit-commercial-benchmarks; chapter number: 3; title: Audit Prices and Delivery Expenditure; subtitle: Separate entry prices, larger engagements, and the cost of delivering an initial free audit.; caption: Antonio on Belt Course describes bronze audit pricing; Andrew Dunn describes larger engagements; Liam Ottley reports initial delivery expenditure and a later engagement.; assumptions note: Antonio's and Andrew Dunn's amounts are range endpoints, not sequential revenue movements. Liam Ottley's $30,000 is delivery expenditure, while $60,000 is a separate engagement. Every bar is an independent total; these amounts do not establish a profit waterfall.; note: Antonio on Belt Course — YaFtlj9qXQc at 00:04:30; Andrew Dunn | AI Consulting describes $5,000–$15,000 engagements; Liam Ottley — noivN2hIXLY at 00:03:53 for the initial free audit's $30,000 delivery cost. Liam also reports progressing to a $60,000 engagement.; chart type: waterfall; bars: label: Antonio bronze lower price; value: 1500; display: $1,500 audit price; kind: total; label: Antonio bronze upper price; value: 3000; display: $3,000 audit price; kind: total; label: Dunn engagement lower price; value: 5000; display: $5,000 engagement; kind: total; label: Dunn engagement upper price; value: 15000; display: $15,000 engagement; kind: total; label: Ottley initial delivery expenditure; value: 30000; display: $30,000 cost, not revenue; kind: total; label: Ottley later engagement; value: 60000; display: $60,000 engagement; kind: total
